Context: 7. Central Administrative Tribunal

7. Ex parte hearing.In the event of the respondent Department/ Ministry not represented at the hearing, the Tribunal may decide the application ex perte. If the respondent subsequently makes an application for setting aside the order, giving sufficient cause to the satisfaction of the Tribunal, it may set aside the ex parte order and hear the case afresh.
